units.en: Court Music of the Jin Dynasty.
units.literal: Our dynasty's musical pieces.

units.zh: 世宗大定九年十一月庚申，皇太子生日，上宴於東宮，命奏新聲，謂大臣曰：「朕制此曲，名《君臣樂》，今天下無事，與卿等共之，不亦樂乎？」
units.en: On a gengshen day in the eleventh month of the ninth year of Dading, Emperor Shizong held a banquet at the Eastern Palace for the crown prince's birthday and ordered new music performed. He told his ministers: "I composed this piece, called 'Joy of Ruler and Subject.' The realm is at peace — to share it with you, what could be more joyful?"
units.literal: On the gengshen day of the eleventh month of the ninth year of Dading under Emperor Shizong, on the crown prince's birthday the emperor banqueted at the Eastern Palace, ordered new music performed, and said to the ministers: "I composed this piece, named 'Joy of Ruler and Subject.' Now the realm is at peace — to share it with you, is this not joy?"

units.en: Its lyrics and melody have not been preserved.
units.literal: Its text and melody are not transmitted.

units.zh: 十三年四月乙亥，上禦睿思殿，命歌者歌女直詞，顧謂皇太子曰：「朕思先朝所行之事，未嘗暫忘，故時聽此詞，亦欲令汝輩知女直醇質之風。
units.en: On a yihai day in the fourth month of the thirteenth year, the emperor attended the Ruisi Hall and ordered singers to perform Jurchen lyrics. Turning to the crown prince, he said: "I never forget, even for a moment, what the former court did; I listen to these songs often so that you too may know the plain and unadorned spirit of our Jurchen forebears.
units.literal: On the yihai day of the fourth month of the thirteenth year, the emperor attended the Ruisi Hall, ordered singers to sing Jurchen lyrics, turned and said to the crown prince: "I think of what the former court did and have never forgotten it even for a moment; therefore I often listen to these lyrics, and also wish to make you know the pure and plain style of the Jurchen.

units.zh: 至於文字、語言或不通曉，是忘本也！」
units.en: If you do not understand our script and language, you have forgotten your roots!"
units.literal: As for writing and speech, if one does not understand them, that is forgetting one's roots!"

units.zh: 二十五年四月，幸上京，宴宗室于皇武殿，飲酒樂，上諭之曰：「今日甚欲成醉，此樂不易得也。
units.en: In the fourth month of the twenty-fifth year he visited the Upper Capital and banqueted the imperial clan in the Huangwu Hall. As they drank and rejoiced, he told them: "Today I mean to drink myself fully drunk — such joy does not come easily.
units.literal: In the fourth month of the twenty-fifth year, he visited the Upper Capital, banqueted the imperial clan in the Huangwu Hall, drank and made merry; the emperor instructed them: "Today I very much wish to become fully drunk — this joy is not easily obtained.

units.zh: 昔漢高祖過故鄉，與父老歡飲，擊築而歌，令諸兒和之。
units.en: Long ago Emperor Gaozu of Han visited his old home, drank merrily with the local elders, struck the zhu and sang, and had his sons join in the chorus.
units.literal: Formerly Emperor Gaozu of Han passed his old home, drank joyfully with the elders, struck the zhu and sang, and ordered his sons to join in harmony.

units.zh: 彼起布衣，尚且如是，況我祖宗世有此土，今天下一統，朕巡幸至此，何不樂飲！」
units.en: He had risen from common cloth and still did as much — how much more should we rejoice, whose ancestors held this land for generations, and who now, with the realm unified, have come on tour to our homeland. Why should we not drink in joy!"
units.literal: He rose from common cloth and still acted thus — how much more so for us, whose ancestors for generations possessed this land; now the realm is unified, and I have come on tour to this place — why not drink in joy!"

units.zh: 于時宗室婦女起舞，進酒畢，群臣故老起舞，上曰：「吾來故鄉數月矣，今回期已近，未嘗有一人歌本曲者，汝曹來前，吾為汝歌。」
units.en: The women of the imperial clan danced, and after wine had been presented, the ministers and elders danced as well. The emperor said: "I have been in my homeland for months now, and our return is near, yet no one has sung the old native melody. Come forward — I shall sing it for you."
units.literal: At that time the women of the imperial clan danced; when wine had been presented, the ministers and old elders danced. The emperor said: "I have been in my old home several months; now the day of return is near, yet not one person has sung the native melody — come forward, all of you, and I will sing for you."

units.zh: 乃命宗室子敘坐殿下者皆上殿，面聽上歌。
units.en: He then ordered all the imperial clansmen seated in ranks below the hall to come up and listen as he sang.
units.literal: He then ordered all the imperial clansmen seated in ranks below the hall to ascend the hall and face him to listen to his singing.

units.zh: 曲道祖宗創業艱難，及所以繼述之意。
units.en: The song spoke of the hardships of the ancestors' founding and of the purpose of carrying their work forward.
units.literal: The piece told of the ancestors' arduous founding of the enterprise and the meaning of how to carry it on.

units.zh: 上既自歌，至慨想祖宗音容如睹之語，悲感不復能成聲，歌畢，泣下數行。
units.en: As he sang and reached the lines recalling the ancestors' faces as though still before him, grief overwhelmed him and his voice broke. When the song ended, tears streamed down his face.
units.literal: When the emperor had sung himself and reached the words about vividly recalling the ancestors' countenance as if seen before him, grief overwhelmed him so he could no longer finish the sound; when the song was done, several streams of tears fell.

units.zh: 右丞相元忠暨群臣宗戚捧觴上壽，皆稱萬歲。
units.en: The right chief minister Yuanzhong, together with the ministers and imperial kin, raised their cups to wish him long life, all shouting "Ten thousand years!"
units.literal: The right chief minister Yuanzhong together with the ministers and imperial kin raised cups to offer longevity, all shouting "ten thousand years."

units.zh: 於是諸老人更歌本曲，如私家相會，暢然歡洽。
units.en: Then the elders sang the native melody again, as at a family gathering, in open and joyful harmony.
units.literal: Thereupon the old men again sang the native melody, like a private family gathering, freely and joyfully harmonious.

units.zh: 上複續調歌曲，留坐一更，極歡而罷。
units.en: The emperor sang on, and the company remained until the first watch of the night, ending in the fullest joy.
units.literal: The emperor again continued tuning and singing pieces, remained seated one watch of the night, and ended in utmost joy.

units.en: The lyrics read:
units.literal: Its text says:

units.en: Alas, our ancestor — how sacred was Wuyuan!
units.literal: Alas, our ancestor — sacred was Wuyuan!

units.en: He received the bright mandate, and his merit shone upon Heaven.
units.literal: He received the bright mandate; his merit shone upon Heaven.

units.en: He rescued the drowning and the desperate, planting deep roots and firm bonds.
units.literal: He saved the drowning and rescued the distressed, planting deep roots and firm bonds.

units.en: He opened the way for our posterity and passed down blessings for ten thousand generations.
units.literal: He opened the way for our posterity and transmitted blessings for ten thousand generations.

units.en: Woe to Prince Hailing — licentious and benighted, guilty of countless crimes.
units.literal: Woe to Hailing — licentious, dim-witted, guilty of many crimes.

units.en: He reversed Heaven's way and brought torment to the realm.
units.literal: He reversed Heaven's way and tormented the realm within the seas.

units.en: From the founding of old down to the succession of the throne.
units.literal: From the founding of old down to succession of the body.

units.en: The accumulated enterprise was on the verge of ruin.
units.literal: The accumulated enterprise was about to sink together and fall.

units.en: All eyes turned to where the mandate leaned, without seeking anyone's consent.
units.literal: All looked to where the mandate leaned; none consulted for agreement.

units.en: The ancestral temple weighed above all else, and human hearts could not refuse.
units.literal: The ancestral temple was of utmost weight; human hearts were hard to refuse.

units.en: Reluctantly accepting joyful advancement, I took up the succession.
units.literal: Reluctantly matching joyful advancement, I extended my succession.

units.en: For twenty-four years I have been diligent in the ten thousand affairs of state.
units.literal: Twenty-four years, diligent in the ten thousand affairs.

units.en: Hundreds of millions of common people live in peace and security.
units.literal: Hundreds of millions of common folk harbor peace and security.

units.en: The state is at ease, broadly free of trouble.
units.literal: The state is at leisure, broadly without affairs.

units.en: Thus my heart turns to the Upper Capital, the founding emperor's domain.
units.literal: Thus I turn affection to the Upper Capital, the founding emperor's domain.

units.en: Now that I have come on this tour, sorrow fills my thoughts.
units.literal: Now that I have come on this tour, sorrowfully I reflect.

units.en: The land and its sights have faded — scarcely what they once were.
units.literal: Scenes and things have diminished and wasted — scarcely as in former times.

units.en: In every village and hamlet, nothing remains as it was at the beginning.
units.literal: In village and in hamlet, none are as at the beginning.

units.en: Though it is no longer as at the beginning, I take joy in it nonetheless.
units.literal: Although not as at the beginning, I myself delight in this.

units.en: Though it is not as in former times, I behold it without estrangement.
units.literal: Although not as in former times, I view it without difference.

units.en: Gazing fondly and sighing, I think of the ancestors' old halls.
units.literal: Gazing fondly and sighing in thought upon the ancestors' old halls.

units.en: Their voices and faces return again and again, as though I could see them still.
units.literal: Their voices and countenances, connected and connected, seem exactly as if seen.

units.en: Childhood play and youthful longing — each place stands clear in memory.
units.literal: Childhood play and youthful longing — each place stands out clearly.

units.en: The paths I walked in my prime seem suddenly as they once were.
units.literal: In the strong years I passed through them; suddenly it seems as of old.

units.en: Companions of years past seem near again, as though it were only yesterday.
units.literal: Companions of old years in travel — dimly, dimly as yesterday.

units.en: Joy and earnest parting feel as close as morning and evening.
units.literal: Joy and earnest parting — as if morning and evening.

units.en: Alas for this long parting — how can we fail to rejoice?
units.literal: Alas for long separation — how is it that we are not joyful?

units.en: Hymns for Suburban Sacrifice.
units.literal: Suburban sacrifice hymn texts.

units.zh: 皇帝入中濆，宮縣黃鐘宮《昌甯之曲》：凡步武同。
units.en: As the emperor enters the central mound, the palace ensemble sounds the Yellow Bell mode, "Prospering Tranquility"; every pace and bearing match the prescribed pattern.
units.literal: The emperor enters the central mound; the palace ensemble plays in Yellow Bell mode, "Prospering Tranquility" — all paces and bearing are alike.

units.en: Robed in dark ceremonial vestments, solemn and still, he approaches the central mound.
units.literal: In dark ceremonial robes, solemn and stately, he draws near the central mound.

units.en: Behold the round altar — how august the Heavenly Sovereign on high.
units.literal: Gazing upon the round altar — august is the Heavenly Sovereign.

units.en: The spirit-sacrifice begins; bell-tones and fragrance rise as offerings of virtue.
units.literal: The spirit-sacrifice is first proclaimed; bell-tone and fragrance are virtue's substance.

units.en: Thus it reaches the hundred spirits, who brightly take up their appointed offices.
units.literal: Thereupon reaching the hundred spirits — they brightly receive their posts.

units.zh: 降神，宮縣《乾甯之曲》、《仁豐道洽之舞》。
units.en: Escorting the spirits down: the palace ensemble plays "Heavenly Tranquility" and the dance "Benevolence Abundant, the Way in Harmony."
units.literal: Escorting the spirits downward: palace ensemble, "Heavenly Tranquility," dance "Benevolence Abundant, the Way Harmonized."

units.zh: 圜鐘為宮，黃鐘為角，太蔟為徵，姑洗為羽。
units.en: The round bells serve as tonic, yellow bell as second, great cluster as third degree, and maiden wash as fifth.
units.literal: Round bells as tonic, yellow bell as second, great cluster as third, maiden wash as fifth.

units.zh: 圜鐘三奏，黃鐘、太蔟、姑洗皆一奏，詞並同：
units.en: The round bells are played thrice; yellow bell, great cluster, and maiden wash each once — the words are the same:
units.literal: Round bells thrice performed; yellow bell, great cluster, and maiden wash each once performed — texts all alike:

units.en: As our Jin dynasty arose, August Heaven granted its blessing.
units.literal: Our Jin's rising — August Heaven bestows favor.

units.en: By the spirits' favor alone we make this suburban appearance.
units.literal: Only the spirits' blessing — here at this suburban manifestation.

units.en: Jade for the rites, victims for the offering.
units.literal: There is jade for the ritual; there are victims for the offering.

units.en: Soon to receive its radiance — come in peace, come to feast.
units.literal: About to receive its brilliance — come in peace, come in feast.

units.zh: 皇帝盥洗，宮縣黃鐘宮《昌甯之曲》：
units.en: The emperor performs the hand-washing; the palace ensemble plays in Yellow Bell mode, "Prospering Tranquility":
units.literal: The emperor washes hands; palace ensemble, Yellow Bell mode, "Prospering Tranquility":

units.en: Serving Heaven through Heaven, he honors the ancestral temple and prepares the rite.
units.literal: Following Heaven to serve Heaven; honoring the ancestral temple in carrying out rites.

units.en: He charges the officers in charge to present the urn and basin at the appointed hour.
units.literal: Thereupon ordering the responsible officials, presenting the timely urn and basin.

units.en: Drawing water there and pouring it here, he ascends the altar steps.
units.literal: Drawing from that, pouring into this — then ascending the altar steps.

units.en: Devout before the rite begins — the spirits' kindly labor brings ease.
units.literal: Before the affair, devout; the spirits' toil is gentle and kind.

units.zh: 皇帝升壇，登歌大呂宮《昌甯之曲》：
units.en: The emperor ascends the altar; the ascent singers perform in great Lü mode, "Prospering Tranquility":
units.literal: The emperor ascends the altar; ascent songs, great Lü mode, "Prospering Tranquility":

units.en: The altar stands south of the capital, its footings rising high and grand.
units.literal: The altar stands in the state's south — lofty, lofty its base.

units.en: How august the sovereign — at this hour he takes his stand.
units.literal: How abundant the august king — at this time he arrives and halts.

units.en: Utmost sincerity reaches the spirits; he worthily performs the spirit-sacrifice and offering.
units.literal: Utmost sincerity penetrates the spirits; he can perform spirit-sacrifice and sacrifice.

units.en: For myriad years — son of August Heaven.
units.literal: For ten thousand years — August Heaven's son.

units.zh: 昊天上帝，奠玉幣，登歌大呂宮《洪甯之曲》：
units.en: To August Heaven the Supreme Lord, offering jade and silks — ascent songs in great Lü mode, "Great Tranquility":
units.literal: August Heaven the Supreme Lord, laying jade and silk; ascent songs, great Lü mode, "Great Tranquility":

units.en: Solemn and still is the king and lord — dignified in bearing, well attended.
units.literal: Solemn, solemn the king and lord — he has severity and has support.

units.en: His belt pendants chime as he climbs the round altar.
units.literal: His belt pendants ring clear; the round altar is what he ascends.

units.en: His fine virtue rises to be heard — the fragrance lies not in grain alone.
units.literal: Fine virtue rises and is heard; fragrance is not from millet and sacrificial grain.

units.en: The High Bright One descends to watch; the hundred spirits take their offices.
units.literal: The High Bright descends to oversee; the hundred spirits receive their posts.

units.en: To the Imperial Earth Spirit — "Earthly Tranquility":
units.literal: Imperial Earth Spirit, "Earthly Tranquility":

units.en: Solemn and reverent toward the clear Earth Spirit, he personally lays the offerings.
units.literal: Solemn and reverent toward the clear spirit; personally performing the laid offerings.

units.en: What offerings are presented?
units.literal: What are its offerings?

units.en: A yellow jade cube and fashioned silks.
units.literal: Yellow jade cube and fashioned silks.

units.en: The host of spirits in attendance — each ranks in its proper place.
units.literal: The attendant-sacrificed host of spirits — all ordered in their places.

units.en: Only the sovereign can receive them; the glorious rite is truly gathered complete.
units.literal: Only the sovereign can feast them; truly gathered is the bright affair.

units.zh: 配位太祖皇帝，《永甯之曲》：
units.en: For the paired seat of Grand Ancestor Emperor — "Eternal Tranquility":
units.literal: The paired seat: Grand Ancestor Emperor, "Eternal Tranquility":

units.en: He first lifts the bright spirit-sacrifice to August Heaven and Queen Earth.
units.literal: First raising the bright spirit-sacrifice — August Heaven, Queen Earth.

units.en: Imperial ancestor Wuyuan, now set as spirit-lord of the rite.
units.literal: Imperial ancestor Wuyuan — thereupon made spirit-lord.

units.en: His merit shines in settled elder peace — hymned in great Yü mode.
units.literal: Merit displayed in aged peace — sung to great Yü.

units.en: To settle our thoughts in fulfillment — blessings heaped rank on rank.
units.literal: To settle our thoughts accomplished — rank upon rank this blessing.

units.zh: 司徒迎俎，宮縣黃鐘宮《豐甯之曲》：
units.en: The Minister of Education receives the offering stand; the palace ensemble plays Yellow Bell mode, "Abundant Tranquility":
units.literal: Minister of Education welcomes the offering stand; palace ensemble, Yellow Bell mode, "Abundant Tranquility":

units.en: Solemn and august, the Son of Heaven performs the sacrifice in person.
units.literal: Solemn, august — the Son of Heaven personally sacrifices.

units.en: The ministers assist him — none without reverent devotion.
units.literal: The host of ministers assist him — none without reverent stillness.

units.en: Stands and vessels are fully set forth — how fine the offerings.
units.literal: Offering stands and vessels all displayed — the things are excellent.

units.en: Fragrant smoke first ascends — the bright spirits feast and rejoice.
units.literal: Fragrant aroma first rises — the bright spirits feast in joy.

units.zh: 昊天上帝，酌獻，登歌大呂宮《嘉甯之曲》：
units.en: To August Heaven the Supreme Lord — libation offering — ascent songs in great Yü mode, "Fine Tranquility":
units.literal: August Heaven the Supreme Lord, libation offering; ascent songs, great Yü mode, "Fine Tranquility":

units.en: At the suburban spirit-sacrifice reverence is shown — brightly serving the spirits on high.
units.literal: Suburban spirit-sacrifice displays reverence; illuminating service to the upper spirits.

units.en: The great wine-jar rests on the mat; strained wine, how fragrant.
units.literal: The great wine-vessel on the mat — there is strained wine, its fragrance.

units.en: We pour and offer it — may the spirits drink their fill.
units.literal: Pouring as one offers it — may the spirits drink their fill and halt.

units.en: Fortune and blessing come as fitting return for the bright sacrifice.
units.literal: Fortune and emolument come fittingly, to answer the bright sacrifice.

units.en: To the Imperial Earth Spirit — "Great Tranquility":
units.literal: Imperial Earth Spirit, "Great Tranquility":

units.en: In dark ceremonial robes, solemn and still, he approaches the great earth-altar.
units.literal: Dark robes solemn, drawing near that great earth-altar.

units.en: How brightly shines the spirit shrine — silks are buried, blood is interred.
units.literal: How bright the spirit shrine — burying silks, interring blood.

units.en: He raises the gourd cup and pours the clean offering.
units.literal: Thereupon raising the gourd cup, pouring words to offer the clean.

units.en: May the square earth realm ever rest in peace and uphold our imperial work.
units.literal: The square earth-carrier ever tranquil — upholding our imperial enterprise.

units.zh: 配位太祖皇帝，《燕甯之曲》：、
units.en: For the paired seat of Grand Ancestor Emperor — "Feasting Tranquility":
units.literal: Paired seat: Grand Ancestor Emperor, "Feasting Tranquility":

units.en: How august the lofty sovereign — who first laid the great foundation.
units.literal: How abundant the lofty sovereign — first opening the great foundation.

units.en: Her merit joins Heaven's — matched with Heaven and exalted.
units.literal: Merit joins with Heaven; paired with Heaven to be exalted.

units.en: Offerings of the season's pure essence — how solemn the ceremony.
units.literal: Offering at the season's clear essence — greatly solemn its observance.

units.en: Come in peace, come to feast — fortune and blessing are settled upon them.
units.literal: Come in peace, come in feast — fortune and emolument settle upon them.

units.zh: 文舞退，武舞進，宮縣黃鐘宮《咸甯之曲》：
units.en: The civil dance withdraws and the martial dance advances; the palace ensemble plays Yellow Bell mode, "Universal Tranquility":
units.literal: Civil dance withdraws, martial dance advances; palace ensemble, Yellow Bell mode, "Universal Tranquility":

units.en: Offering sacrifice at the suburban mound — the transformed dance of "Cloud Gate."
units.literal: Performing sacrifice at the suburban mound — "Cloud Gate" transformation dance.

units.en: Advancing with vermilion staffs in hand; halting, waving pheasant-feather plumes.
units.literal: Advancing, grasping vermilion staffs; stopping, waving pheasant plumes.

units.en: How brightly shines the sage culture — echoing the holy martial once more.
units.literal: How bright the sagely culture — again resembling the holy martial.

units.en: Boundless is the merit — the Son of Heaven receives Heaven's grace.
units.literal: Without boundary is the merit — the Son of Heaven receives blessing.

units.zh: 亞終獻，宮縣黃鐘宮《咸甯之曲》、《功成治定之舞》：
units.en: The second and final offerings — palace ensemble in Yellow Bell mode, "Universal Tranquility," and the dance "Merit Accomplished, Order Settled":
units.literal: Second and final offerings; palace ensemble, Yellow Bell mode, "Universal Tranquility," dance "Merit Accomplished, Order Settled":

units.zh: 掃地南郊，天神以俟，于皇君王，克禋克祀。
units.en: The southern suburb is swept clean; Heaven's spirits await — how august the sovereign, worthily performing spirit-sacrifice and offering.
units.literal: Sweeping the ground at the southern suburb, Heaven's spirits thereby wait; how august the king and lord — he can perform spirit-sacrifice and sacrifice.

units.en: He communes with the spirits — dark wine in earthen vessels.
units.literal: Exchanging with the spirits bright; dark wine in earthenware.

units.en: The heart is sincere, still, and pure — the rite values not rich flavors.
units.literal: Sincere mind tranquil and pure — not valuing flavors of food.

units.zh: 皇帝飲福，登歌大呂宮《福甯之曲》：
units.en: The emperor partakes of the blessing-wine — ascent songs in great Yü mode, "Blessing Tranquility":
units.literal: The emperor drinks blessing; ascent songs, great Yü mode, "Blessing Tranquility":

units.en: To receive Heaven's mandate, nothing exceeds simplicity.
units.literal: That by which one receives Heaven — nothing surpasses simplicity.

units.en: Heaven blesses him — in refinement and singleness of purpose alone.
units.literal: Heaven will bless it — only refinement, only unity.

units.en: From the great wine-jar he pours — fragrance offering up virtue.
units.literal: The great vessel thereupon drawn — fragrant aroma offering virtue.

units.en: Favor us without end — sons and grandsons beyond counting.
units.literal: Favor us without boundary — descendants by the billion.

units.zh: 徹豆，登歌大呂宮《豐甯之曲》：
units.en: The vessels are removed — ascent songs in great Yü mode, "Abundant Tranquility":
units.literal: Removing the vessels; ascent songs, great Yü mode, "Abundant Tranquility":

units.en: The great rite is now set forth — the offering vessels ample and full.
units.literal: The great rite thereupon displayed — the vessels for offerings greatly ample.

units.en: Grave and orderly their bearing — how glorious the host of lords.
units.literal: Solemn, solemn their bearing — how manifest the hundred lords.

units.en: The august spirits descend to watch — fragrance is heard in virtue alone.
units.literal: The august numen descends to oversee; fragrance heard lies in virtue.

units.en: The bright spirit-sacrifice stands complete — blessing and joy without bound.
units.literal: The bright spirit-sacrifice is thereby accomplished — good faith and felicity without limit.

units.zh: 送神，宮縣圜鐘宮《乾甯之曲》：
units.en: Escorting the spirits away — the palace ensemble plays in round-bell mode, "Heavenly Tranquility":
units.literal: Escorting the spirits away; palace ensemble, round-bell mode, "Heavenly Tranquility":

units.en: Splendid and bright the Supreme Lord — overseeing the spirit-sacrifice.
units.literal: Splendid, splendid Supreme Lord — overseeing the spirit-sacrifice.

units.en: They came to partake in solemn presence — brightly answering ancestor and consort.
units.literal: Securely, solemnly they come to savor — brightly answering ancestor and paired spirit.

units.en: The round altar stands complete in four tiers — the spirits rest in their places.
units.literal: The round altar four tiers complete — spirits rest in their places.

units.en: Ascent songs praise the farewell — Heaven and humanity rejoice together.
units.literal: Ascent songs praise the send-off — Heaven's people joyful and pleased.

units.en: Hymns for the Square-Mound Altar.
units.literal: Square-mound altar hymn texts.

units.en: Welcoming the spirits — "Supreme Tranquility."
units.literal: Welcoming the spirits — "Supreme Tranquility."

units.zh: 大鐘宮再奏，太蔟角再奏，姑洗徵再奏，南呂羽再奏，詞同：
units.en: Great bell as tonic played twice, great cluster as second twice, maiden wash as third twice, southern Yü as fifth twice — the words are the same:
units.literal: Great bell mode twice performed, great cluster second twice, maiden wash third twice, southern Yü fifth twice — texts alike:

units.en: Utmost is the form of Earth — the myriad beings live by its sustenance.
units.literal: How utmost the Kun trigram's form — ten thousand things rely on it for life.

units.en: It measures each thing and grants evenly — humility flows forth and fullness is transformed.
units.literal: Weighing things, evenly bestowing — flowing humility, transforming fullness.

units.en: Rites are perfected at the great earth-altar — sacrifice in utmost sincerity.
units.literal: Rites perfected at the great earth-altar — sacrifice utmost in pure sincerity.

units.en: August is the spirits' favor — forever securing the realm within the four seas.
units.literal: August, august the spirit's regard — forever settling the realm within the seas.

units.zh: 初獻盥洗，太蔟宮《肅甯之曲》：
units.en: First offering — hand-washing — in great cluster mode, "Solemn Tranquility":
units.literal: First offering hand-washing; great cluster mode, "Solemn Tranquility":

units.en: Among the five classics of ritual, none comes before the rites of sacrifice.
units.literal: Rites have five classics — none precedes sacrificial rites.

units.en: Sincerity is offered forthwith; hand-washing comes only at the appointed hour.
units.literal: At once extending sincerity — only at the proper time hand-washing.

units.en: Every offering is purified for the rite; bearing and ceremony stand grave and complete.
units.literal: Each thing auspiciously purified — bearing and observance orderly and full.

units.en: Grant them pure blessing; come to partake in harmony and gentle grace.
units.literal: Bestowing upon them pure blessing — come to savor, harmonious and yielding.

units.zh: 初獻升壇，應鐘宮《肅甯之曲》：
units.en: First offering — ascent to the altar — in response-bell mode, "Solemn Tranquility":
units.literal: First offering ascends the altar; response-bell mode, "Solemn Tranquility":

units.en: Boundless is its virtue — utmost is the origin of Earth!
units.literal: Boundless virtue — how utmost the Kun origin!

units.en: Latent yet firm in strength, it sustains all life in true abundance.
units.literal: Submerged yet firm in overcoming — sustaining life, truly abundant.

units.en: The rite at the square-mound altar honors reverence alone, not display.
units.literal: The square-mound altar's observance — only reverence, no ornament.

units.en: May the spirits come — in season they savor the ample offering.
units.literal: May the spirits come! — timely savor, abundant offering.

units.zh: 初獻奠玉幣，太蔟宮《億甯之曲》：
units.en: First offering — presentation of jade and silks — in great cluster mode, "Abundant Tranquility":
units.literal: First offering presents jade and silks; great cluster mode, "Abundant Tranquility":

units.en: The rite proceeds at the square marsh-altar; regalia and vessels are fully set forth.
units.literal: Rites performed at the square marsh-altar — regalia and vessels fully displayed.

units.en: To the august Imperial Earth Spirit alone.
units.literal: Only the august Imperial Earth Spirit.

units.en: Brightly summoned, the spirits descend.
units.literal: Brightly summoned, they descend.

units.en: Jade and silks are offered and buried; pure sincerity dwells within.
units.literal: Offering and burying jade and silks — pure sincerity shown within.

units.en: The spirits guard and partake; in their going and coming, blessing is bestowed.
units.literal: The spirits guard and enjoy — ascending and descending, this blessing.

units.zh: 司徒捧俎，太蔟宮《豐甯之曲》：
units.en: The Minister of Education bears the offering stand — in great cluster mode, "Abundant Tranquility":
units.literal: Minister of Education bears the offering stand; great cluster mode, "Abundant Tranquility":

units.en: Four tiers in ordered ceremony — the altar stands at the square marsh-altar.
units.literal: Four tiers, ordered observance — altar at the square marsh-altar.

units.en: Brightly serving the august Earth Spirit — facing the north upon the earthen altar.
units.literal: Brightly serving the august Earth Spirit — facing yin upon the earthen mound.

units.en: Pure offerings are set at the side-altar — how excellent and how full.
units.literal: Pure offerings displayed at the side-altar — greatly excellent and ample.

units.en: May the spirits bless it — in number and in form as the rite prescribes.
units.literal: May the spirits bless it — like so many, like the rite.

units.zh: 正位酌獻，太蔟宮《溥甯之曲》：
units.en: Principal seat — libation offering — in great cluster mode, "Broad Tranquility":
units.literal: Principal seat, libation offering; great cluster mode, "Broad Tranquility":

units.en: Vast is the virtue of Earth — nothing lies outside its bearing.
units.literal: Vast, vast the Kun virtue — nothing it does not bear.

units.en: Yielding and compliant, firm and steadfast — it embraces greatness and vast light.
units.literal: Yielding, compliant, advantageous, steadfast — embracing greatness, vast brightness.

units.en: Stands and vessels stand arrayed; bells and chimes are in their place.
units.literal: Stands and vessels already displayed — metal and stone are there.

units.en: May the four seas know lasting peace — fortune and blessing bestowed therein.
units.literal: Within the four seas everlasting peace — fortune and emolument therein conferred.

units.zh: 配位酌獻配太宗也，太蔟宮《保甯之曲》：
units.en: Paired seat — libation offering to Taizong — in great cluster mode, "Preserving Tranquility":
units.literal: Paired seat libation offering — paired with Grand Ancestor Taizong; great cluster mode, "Preserving Tranquility":

units.en: The hymn text is missing.
units.literal: Text lacuna.

units.zh: 亞終獻升壇，太蔟宮《咸甯之曲》：
units.en: Secondary and final offering — ascent to the altar — in great cluster mode, "All-Pervading Tranquility":
units.literal: Secondary and final offering ascends the altar; great cluster mode, "All-Pervading Tranquility":

units.en: Lofty stands that fine altar — jade is offered at the square marsh-altar.
units.literal: Lofty that fine altar — presenting jade at the square marsh-altar.

units.en: The host of lords stand in reverent order; the eight tones ring pure and clear.
units.literal: The hundred lords reverently solemn — eight tones purely performed.

units.en: The sacrifice shines complete; the yielding earth spirits are moved and descend.
units.literal: Sacrificial affairs brightly accomplished — yielding earth spirits moved and received.

units.en: The vessels are removed — in response-bell mode, "Abundant Tranquility":
units.literal: Removing the vessels; response-bell mode, "Abundant Tranquility":

units.en: The square-mound altar is made ready; auspicious purification is meet.
units.literal: Preparing the square-mound altar — auspicious purification is fitting.

units.en: Stands and vessels rest still and fine; offerings are set before the presiding officers.
units.literal: Stands and vessels tranquil and excellent — presented to the officials in charge.

units.en: Fragrance rises rich and full — come to feast, come in due observance.
units.literal: Rich, rich fragrant aroma — come to feast, come in observance.

units.en: The suburban rite draws near its close; music and song accompany the withdrawal.
units.literal: The suburban rite nears its end — sound and song carry the removal through.

units.en: Escorting the spirits away — in forest-bell mode, "Pacifying Tranquility":
units.literal: Escorting the spirits away; forest-bell mode, "Pacifying Tranquility":

units.en: By the earth's square-mound altar — observances stand grave, full, and many.
units.literal: Following the earth's square mound — orderly and full, many observances.

units.en: Music completes its eight changes; spirits and earth deities descend in presence.
units.literal: Music completed in eight changes — numen and earth spirits descend in thought.

units.en: Offerings are cleared and vessels withdrawn; the spirits' gift shines forth.
units.literal: Offering remainder, removing vessels — divine gift brightly bestowed.

units.en: For ten thousand ages — may the great foundation be blessed forever.
units.literal: By the billion such years — forever blessing the great foundation.

units.zh: 詣望燎位，太蔟宮《肅甯之曲》。
units.en: Proceeding to the sighting-burn position — in great cluster mode, "Solemn Tranquility."
units.literal: Proceeding to the sighting-burn position; great cluster mode, "Solemn Tranquility."

units.en: The words are the same as for ascending the altar.
units.literal: Text same as ascending the altar.
